name: video-downloader-backend
description: High-performance Node.js & Express TypeScript backend for video link analysis and download streaming

scripts.kill:port: powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { if($_ -gt 0) { taskkill /F /PID $_ } }; Write-Host 'Port 5000 is completely free!'"
